invariants.rationale: operationType is typically specified to determine the type of compaction operation.
table is used for multiple method calls and field accesses, so it must not be null.
pendingCompactionTimeline is accessed for containsInstant, so it must not be null.
instantTime is passed to getCompactionInflightInstant and likely cannot be null.
The method throws an exception if operationType is LOG_COMPACT; thus this should not hold at method entry in expected usage.
